Accessories.description: Accessories received with the machine (SRS 2.1). Unknown keys are rejected.

receivedDate.description: Default = today (Asia/Bangkok). Max 1 day in the future.

warrantyExpiryDate.description: Required when IN_WARRANTY; not allowed otherwise

name.example: บจก. ชวัลชา

allOf.description: Partial update. status, technicianId, jobNumber and customer.phone are rejected (400).

post.description: Authenticates an employee by username and password. Returns a 12-hour JWT token.

patch.summary: Update employee details or deactivate (Admin only)
Update employee status and trigger auto-assignment

get.description: Any staff role. Business-minute timers (progress reminders, needsProgressUpdate) skip these dates.

200.description: [{ id, date, name, createdAt, createdBy: { id, name } }] ordered by date

post.summary: Add a shop holiday, or a range of consecutive closed days (ADMIN)

409.description: One of the dates is already a holiday (details.existingDates)

get.description: Returns only the caller's own notifications, newest first. Any authenticated role.

200.description: { total, unreadCount, page, limit, totalPages, notifications: [{ id, type, repairOrderId, title, body, payload, createdAt, readAt }] }

patch.summary: Mark one of my notifications as read
patch.description: Idempotent (readAt keeps its first value). Another employee's notification returns 404.

404.description: Not found (or belongs to someone else)

post.description:
Registers or updates customer, registers machine, links symptoms, and opens a repair order with NEW status
using the fields of the paper intake form (SRS 2). Accessible by RECEPTIONIST and ADMIN.
Required minimum: customer name + phone, machine brand + model, at least one symptom.

400.description: Validation failed (e.g. unknown accessories key, IN_WARRANTY without warrantyExpiryDate, receivedDate in the future).

409.description: paperReceiptNo is already used by another repair order.

get.summary: List repair orders with filtering and pagination

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Matches jobNumber, paperReceiptNo, paperBookNo, customer phone or customer name (max 100 chars)

parameters.name: needsProgressUpdate
parameters.description: true = active jobs (INSPECTING / WAITING_APPROVAL / REPAIRING) idle for at least PROGRESS_REMINDER_INTERVAL_MINUTES of business time; rows include idleBusinessMinutes (TECHNICIAN own, ADMIN all)

parameters.name: awaitingAck
parameters.description: true = only jobs reserved for a technician but not yet accepted (ADMIN sees all, TECHNICIAN sees own)

get.description: TECHNICIAN sees only orders assigned to them (including ones awaiting acceptance); unassigned NEW orders are not listed. Each row includes assignedAt and waitingMinutes (minutes a reserved job has waited for acceptance, null otherwise).

200.description: List of repair orders (summary incl. paperReceiptNo, paperBookNo, receivedDate, warrantyStatus)

get.summary: Get repair order details by ID
get.description:
Full intake data (paper form fields, warranty, accessories, careAdvice, ...), items with
quantity / unitPrice / amount / itemType / barcode / resolution fields, and totalAmount
(sum of the amounts of all items, no VAT/discount). TECHNICIAN may only view orders assigned to them.
Also returns payment (see PUT /payment) and allowedActions: the buttons the caller may use on this order —
ACCEPT, RELEASE, ADD_ITEM, RESOLVE_ITEM, COMPLETE_ITEM, START_REPAIR, STILL_WORKING, COMPLETE,
COMPLETE_NOT_REPAIRED, REWORK, DELIVER, RECORD_PAYMENT, EDIT_HELPERS, EDIT_INTAKE, CANCEL. The web app shows a
button only when its action is listed; the endpoints enforce the same rules.

403.description: Forbidden (Technician viewing an order not assigned to them, including unassigned NEW orders)

patch.summary: Edit intake data of a repair order
patch.description:
RECEPTIONIST/ADMIN only. Edits paper-form / customer (name, address) / machine / symptoms / warranty /
accessories / loaner / billingType / careAdvice / warningNote / receivedDate / paperBookNo / paperReceiptNo.
Cannot change status, technicianId or jobNumber. Not allowed on DELIVERED or CANCELLED orders.
A StatusLog entry records who edited which fields (field names only).

200.description: Updated repair order details (same shape as GET /api/repairs/{id})

409.description: Order is DELIVERED/CANCELLED, or paperReceiptNo already used

post.summary: Accept a reserved job (technician "รับงานนี้")
post.description:
The assigned TECHNICIAN accepts the job reserved for them, or an ADMIN accepts on their behalf
(logged as such). NEW -> INSPECTING and technician RESERVED -> BUSY. A job that was returned to
the pool from a deactivated technician resumes at WAITING_APPROVAL (PENDING items), REPAIRING
(APPROVED/COMPLETED items) or INSPECTING.

200.description: Accepted; returns the repair order details

403.description: RECEPTIONIST, or a technician the job is not reserved for

409.description: Not waiting for acceptance (already accepted, unassigned, or other status)

post.summary: Release a reserved job back to the pool (ADMIN)
post.description:
Only for a job reserved for a technician that has not been accepted yet. The order goes back to
the pool (technicianId cleared), the technician returns to AVAILABLE, and the queue runs again.

200.description: Released; returns the repair order details (it may already be reserved for another technician)

post.summary: Add a repair item and trigger approval loop
post.description:
Adds an item (PART / TRAVEL_FEE / LABOR_HOURS / SERVICE_FEE) to the repair order. Accessible by the assigned
TECHNICIAN or ADMIN. Response item includes quantity, unitPrice, amount (= quantity x unitPrice), itemType,
barcode and the legacy `price` alias (= unitPrice, kept temporarily).

patch.summary: Record the customer's price decision for an item (phone confirmation)
patch.description:
SRS 3.4: the shop confirms prices with the customer by phone and records the result per item.
Allowed: RECEPTIONIST, ADMIN, and the TECHNICIAN assigned to the order (other technicians 403).
Stores resolvedById, resolvedAt, resolutionChannel = PHONE and the optional note. When every item is
decided the order moves to REPAIRING (at least one approved) or back to INSPECTING (all rejected).

note.example: โทรคุยกับเจ้าของร้าน 14:20

post.summary: Submit finished repair work ("ส่งงานซ่อม")
post.description:
The assigned TECHNICIAN (or an ADMIN) completes a REPAIRING order with a summary. Every APPROVED item must be
COMPLETED first (409 with the count). Optional helperTechnicianIds records technicians who helped
(informational only, active technicians other than the owner). The technician becomes AVAILABLE when they
hold no other job and is immediately offered the next job in the queue.
outcome NOT_REPAIRED ("ลูกค้าไม่ซ่อม") closes an INSPECTING or REPAIRING order without repair; the machine is
then handed back through DELIVERED as usual and the customer LINE message says it was not repaired.

200.description: Completed; returns the repair order details

403.description: Not the assigned technician / not allowed

409.description: Not REPAIRING, or approved items not yet completed

post.summary: "ยังซ่อมอยู่" — confirm the job is still in progress
post.description: Restarts the progress-reminder timer (lastActivityAt) and clears the unanswered counter. Assigned TECHNICIAN or ADMIN; only while INSPECTING / WAITING_APPROVAL / REPAIRING.

200.description: Timer reset; returns the repair order details

403.description: Not the assigned technician / not allowed

409.description: Order is not in an active work status

put.summary: Set the helper technicians of a job
put.description: RECEPTIONIST / ADMIN replace the list of helper technicians (informational only) until the order is DELIVERED or CANCELLED. An empty list clears it.

200.description: Updated; returns the repair order details (helpers listed)

400.description: Invalid technician ids (owner, inactive, not a technician)

put.summary: Record or correct the payment of a COMPLETED / DELIVERED order (RECEPTIONIST, ADMIN)
put.description:
Record only, never blocks delivery. The detail response has payment { payableAmount (APPROVED + COMPLETED
items), paidAmount, status NOT_RECORDED | MATCHED | DIFFERENT, warning { code, message } | null, method, note,
paidAt, recordedBy }. Every change is written to the status log.

200.description: Recorded; returns the repair order details

409.description: Order is not COMPLETED or DELIVERED

post.summary: Upload photos of a repair order (multipart)
post.description:
multipart/form-data: field "files" (1..IMAGE_MAX_PER_KIND files) and field "kind".
INTAKE / RECEIPT_PAPER: RECEPTIONIST, ADMIN. DELIVERY / OTHER: the assigned TECHNICIAN, RECEPTIONIST, ADMIN.
The file content is checked (JPEG, PNG or WebP only; HEIC/HEIF -> 415), auto-rotated, all EXIF/GPS metadata
removed, shrunk to IMAGE_MAX_LONG_EDGE and stored as JPEG. At most IMAGE_MAX_PER_KIND images per kind per order
(409). Not allowed on DELIVERED/CANCELLED orders (409). Images are never public. Returns the image list.

201.description: [{ id, kind, createdAt, uploadedBy: { id, name } }]

400.description: Missing files / invalid kind / too many files in one request

403.description: Not allowed for this kind or not the assigned technician

409.description: Per-kind limit reached or order closed

413.description: A file is larger than IMAGE_MAX_BYTES

415.description: Not a JPEG / PNG / WebP image

get.summary: List photo metadata of a repair order
get.description: ADMIN / RECEPTIONIST any order; TECHNICIAN only their own. No storage paths are returned.

200.description: [{ id, kind, createdAt, uploadedBy: { id, name } }]

get.description: Same visibility as the list. The image must belong to this order. Cache-Control private, no-store.

404.description: Not found, not of this order, or the file is gone

patch.summary: Mark an approved item as completed
patch.description: Sets status of an approved item to COMPLETED. Accessible by assigned technician or ADMIN.

Updates repair order status. Accessible by all authenticated roles (TECHNICIAN must be assigned technician). COMPLETED uses the same rules as POST /complete; technicians must use POST /complete (403 here).

payment.description: Only with status DELIVERED. Payment received at handover (record only, never required).

get.summary: Get all symptoms grouped by category

200.description: [{ id, name, symptoms: [{ id, name, categoryId }] }]

post.summary: Add a symptom to a category (ADMIN)

name.example: ไม่มีน้ำออกจากหัวชง

409.description: Same name already exists in this category

patch.summary: Rename a symptom or move it to another category (ADMIN)
patch.description: Renaming also changes how existing orders display it. Send name and/or categoryId.

409.description: Same name already exists in the target category

delete.summary: Delete a symptom that no repair order uses (ADMIN)

post.description:
Search by ONE number: a job number "REP-YYMM-NNNN" or the paper receipt number (1-10 digits).
Phone numbers are not accepted. Returns a whitelist only: jobNumber, status, statusLabelTh, receivedDate,
updatedAt, machine { brand, model }, timeline [{ status, statusLabelTh, at }] (consecutive repeats collapsed).
Every not-found case (unknown number, wrong format, missing body) returns the same 404 body.
Rate limited per IP (PUBLIC_SEARCH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX / 15 min, default 30).

404.description: { status: "error", message: "ไม่พบข้อมูลใบงาน กรุณาตรวจสอบเลขที่อีกครั้ง" }

429.description: Too many searches from this IP

post.summary: Link the customer's LINE account to one repair order (LIFF)
post.description:
lineAccessToken is a LIFF access token; the server verifies it with LINE (channel must be
LINE_LOGIN_CHANNEL_ID) and takes the userId from LINE — a lineUserId is never accepted from the client.
The phone must match the customer's phone on file. Idempotent. One LINE account may link many orders and
one order may be linked to several accounts. Every failure returns the same 400 body. 10 requests / 15 min / IP.

200.description: { subscribed: true, alreadySubscribed, jobNumber, status, statusLabelTh }

400.description: Generic failure (unknown order, wrong phone or invalid token)

429.description: Too many attempts from this IP

get.summary: Establish SSE connection for live tracking
get.description: Opens a persistent Server-Sent Events stream using an order trackingToken. Each event is exactly { status, updatedAt }.

post.description: Receives events from LINE. Do not require Auth.

200.description: Returns server status and database connection state.
